verdict.rationale: Community reports show TeamViewer runs on Windows (a gaming PC host) and has a Mac client used to control another desktop, which hints at multi-platform desktop coverage. Nothing documents a full platform matrix, mobile viewer or host apps (the Mobile SDK and device-management items are adjacent features), or cross-OS host/viewer sessions. Missing for 10: first-party supported-platform list, evidence of mobile viewer/host clients, explicit confirmation that host and viewer can run on different OSes (e.g., Mac controlling Windows), Linux coverage.

support.subject: As a power user, clients cover the desktop and mobile platforms I use, and host and viewer can run on different operating systems

citations.quote: you can't install TeamViewer on Mac without admin permissions even just to control another desktop
Uses TeamViewer on one gaming PC only to log into Windows and start Steam
